scope: Signed retained checkpoints over exact A1 issuer credential-history and revocation evidence, plus a bounded non-authorizing effect-boundary freshness check. No global currentness oracle or runtime effect admission is created.
core_invariant: Known-active under an exact retained issuer-evidence set is not global currentness and is not authority. A stale, truncated, rewritten, revoked, expired, not-yet-valid, signer-substituted or unexpected retained head fails closed for a new-effect currentness check.

controls: credential history must extend by prefix
prior revocations must remain a subset of later checkpoints
revocation must bind a credential in supplied history
v1 rejects multiple revocations for one credential

risks: multiple principals presented as a proven delegation chain
reuse an old active observation long after it was made
controls: effect time cannot precede checkpoint evaluation
caller freshness requirement is hard-capped at 60 seconds in A6a
currentness is re-evaluated at the proposed effect timestamp against the exact checkpoint-bound evidence set

risks: make historical evidence unverifiable after key rotation
controls: historical checkpoints remain independently verifiable against their exact historical evidence
latest-head expectation is a separate current-use check
credential history is append-only by digest prefix

risks: assume checking several principals proves their delegation relation
allow one active principal to mask another revoked principal
controls: A3b ancestor relationship remains a separate missing prerequisite

known_nonclaims: A6a does not provide a global revocation/currentness oracle.
A6a does not prove a delegation or ancestor relationship between principals.
A6a does not authorize an effect, handoff, grant or delegation.
A6a does not prove consume-before-effect occurred.
A6a does not itself integrate with the accepted Gateway/Hypervisor/Sandbox/Grid effect boundary.
A6a does not solve A5b effect-specific receipt composition with the separate #1137 laboratory stack.
A6a does not modify the capability registry or supported production claims.
next_gates: bind retained checkpoint heads to an independently operated currentness/revocation source or equivalent witness policy
bind A3b delegation ancestors when an authority-bearing delegation contract exists
check the full verified ancestor set as late as safely possible in an actual consume-before-effect path
retain signed latest heads across restart so rollback cannot be hidden by local-state loss
compose A6 currentness evidence into A5 portable receipts as evidence actually consulted
